Website privacy

This page describes this SuraLink website. The mobile app has a separate privacy notice.

A simple website

This website does not include analytics scripts, advertising trackers, account registration, payment forms, or marketing cookies. The word exploration runs in your browser and does not send your selections to us.

Links and hosting

Opening an App Store link takes you to Apple, where Apple’s privacy practices apply. A hosting provider may process standard request information, including an IP address and browser details, to deliver and secure the website. Hosting details should be added here when a production host is selected.

Getting in touch

If you choose to email zaine.raja@gmail.com, your email service sends the information you include. Please do not send sensitive information.
